description_full: IDP Education Limited provides student placement services in Asia, Australasia, and internationally. The company is involved in the placement of international students into education institutions; and provides services, such as digital marketing, events, consultancy and data services, and peer to peer software. It also distributes and administrates International English Language Testing System (IELTS) tests for study, work, and migration purposes. In addition, the company operates English language schools. Further, it engages in the provision of english language teaching, client relations, digital marketing and online students recruitment, online, shared, employee share scheme trust, and technology services. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Melbourne, Australia.

financial_summary: IDP EDUCATION LIMITED is a small-cap consumer defensive business with a $565M market cap on $539M of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at -7% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome. Operating margins are contracting by -5.4pp, the first warning that competitive pressure is eroding the franchise.

Returns on capital run at 15% against a 6% cost of capital, a 8-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it. Gross margins of 100% confirm genuine pricing power.
The business throws off $70M in free cash flow — roughly 13 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 3.5× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and thin 3.0× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.
Shareholder yield of 3.0% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 7.2% of the shares.
